description_short: Complex cross-table query that groups anisotropic SiO2 ALE processes by fluorocarbon precursor family and aggregates etch rates, ion-energy windows, and selectivities across Tables I, II, and III.

paper.title: Atomic Layer Etching of SiO2 for Nanoscale Semiconductor Devices: A Review

tables_modeled.label: Table I
tables_modeled.description: Anisotropic SiO2 ALE processes with fluorocarbon-based chemistries and corresponding etch rates.

tables_modeled.label: Table II
tables_modeled.description: SiO2 ALE conditions including ion-energy windows in the removal step, for various fluorocarbon precursors.

tables_modeled.label: Table III
tables_modeled.description: SiO2 ALE selectivity data (SiO2/Si and SiO2/Si3N4) together with fluorination precursors.

properties_used.label: Precursor chemistries for fluorination
properties_used.role: Fluorocarbon precursor for the SiO2 ALE fluorination step; used to derive fluorocarbon family keys and to align entries across Tables I–III.

properties_used.label: Etching rate
properties_used.role: SiO2 etch rate in Å/cycle from Tables I and II; numeric tokens are extracted and used to compute mean and maximum etch rates per precursor family.

properties_used.label: Ion energy in removal step
properties_used.role: Ion-energy window for the removal step from Table II; represented as strings and aggregated to a representative ion-energy window per precursor family.

properties_used.label: Selectivity material pair
properties_used.role: Material selectivity pair (e.g. SiO2/Si, SiO2/Si3N4) from Table III; used to distinguish SiO2/Si and SiO2/Si3N4 selectivities.

properties_used.label: Selectivity value
properties_used.role: Textual selectivity value or range from Table III; numeric tokens are extracted to compute maximum selectivities for SiO2/Si and SiO2/Si3N4 per precursor family.

aggregation.description: A fluorocarbon precursor family is defined by normalizing the precursor label to lowercase and taking the first token before a '/' or space (e.g. 'C4F8/Ar plasma' → 'c4f8'). All measurements for precursors sharing this family key are grouped together.

output_shape.description: One row per fluorocarbon precursor family summarizing etch behavior, ion-energy conditions, and selectivities for anisotropic SiO2 ALE.
columns: precursor_family: normalized name of the fluorocarbon precursor family (e.g. 'c4f8', 'chf3', 'c3f7och3').
mean_etch_rate: average SiO2 etch rate (Å/cycle) for that family across Tables I and II.
max_etch_rate: maximum SiO2 etch rate (Å/cycle) for that family across Tables I and II.
ion_energy_windows: representative ion-energy window(s) in the removal step for that family as reported in Table II.
max_sel_SiO2_Si: maximum SiO2/Si selectivity observed for that family in Table III.
max_sel_SiO2_Si3N4: maximum SiO2/Si3N4 selectivity observed for that family in Table III.

postprocessing_notes.interpretation: The query provides a family-level summary of anisotropic SiO2 ALE, showing which fluorocarbon chemistries combine favorable selectivity (against Si and Si3N4), high etch rates, and characteristic ion-energy windows, thereby supporting comparative process design and hypothesis generation for new ALE experiments.
